opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an exceptional, independent researcher with a permanent or fixed-term UK university or not‑for‑profit position, have teaching and admin duties, and be based in the UK. Co‑applicant must be a complementary researcher from a different Academy remit, also based in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Cross‑disciplinary award for established researchers to pursue interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research across the humanities, social sciences, science and engineering.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or recognised research organisation, must have completed their viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027 and not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year award to support early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to complete a significant piece of publishable research.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO, ordinarily resident in the UK, and working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Award to support UK researchers to develop new quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities or language skills and to pilot innovative methods.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher in the humanities or social sciences, at any career stage, who will work with a GLAM or performing arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Public‑engagement awards to support innovative projects that bring humanities and social sciences research to wider audiences.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators from the humanities or social sciences, with an established role, must collaborate with overseas co‑applicants and include at least one non‑humanities/social‑science discipline.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects led by UK researchers, working with international partners on themes of mobilities.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: DGAP 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑career or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, with a permanent or fixed‑term UK appointment.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at the German Council on Foreign Relations in Berlin, supporting policy‑relevant research and knowledge mobilisation.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Symposium attendance and seed‑funding for collaborative projects on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’. Travel, accommodation and visa costs are covered.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support specific additional needs (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility support) for award‑holders or applicants.
